# Go conformance fixtures

Known-answer vectors produced by the Go reference implementation, used by `tests/go_conformance.rs`.

Copied unmodified from celestia-rs (`conformance/fixtures/`, commit d5f8475), where they are generated by `conformance/fixturegen/cmd/nmt_vectors.go` and `square_vectors.go` with Go 1.24.11.

| File | Source | Go packages |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hashes.json`, `roots.json`, `proofs.json`, `malformed.json` | `fixtures/nmt/` | `github.com/celestiaorg/nmt v0.24.3`, 8-byte namespaces |
| `erasure.json` | `fixtures/square/` | `github.com/celestiaorg/nmt v0.24.3`, `github.com/celestiaorg/rsmt2d v0.14.0`, `github.com/celestiaorg/go-square v1.0.1`, 29-byte namespaces |

Leaves in the `nmt` fixtures are Go raw leaves, `namespace || data`.

`share_proofs.json` holds per-row NMT proofs taken from `ShareProof` responses that celestia-app served for `/custom/txInclusionProof` and `/custom/shareInclusionProof` queries, recorded in celestia-rs `conformance/querycorpus/`. It is a deduplicated subset: at most three rows for each combination of share count, sibling count, whether the range starts at 0, and namespace.
